summary: REQ-2 appears largely implemented in MusicPlayer (muted autoplay attempt, looping, bottom-right play/pause popup, visible <audio> with controls, no tap-to-start prompt). HeroSection adds a static fallback background URL, but the diff does not add the required image asset nor reference the requested default filename. No diff evidence confirms the Image Memory / Video Memory grid requirements or the Media Manager per-slot mobile controls.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the user-uploaded image (1770099054248.png) as the default Hero background when no uploaded hero background exists, and allow uploaded hero background to override it.
missing_requirements.reason: HeroSection falls back to '/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_736x964.png' rather than the requested '1770099054248.png'. Also, the diff does not show bundling the requested image asset.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure Image Memory section renders a responsive grid of 43 image cards with 3D flip/rotate and fade-in message reveal, rounded corners, and soft shadow.
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence shows changes or confirmation for ImageMemorySection / flip-card rendering behavior, slot count (43), or animations.

missing_requirements.requirement: In Media Manager working mode, provide clear mobile-friendly per-image-slot controls (add/replace, adjust, reorder) and ensure grid updates after submit without refresh.
missing_requirements.reason: MediaManager.tsx diff is truncated and does not show the per-slot controls UI, reorder interactions, or post-publish refresh behavior in the Image Memory grid.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure Video Memory section renders a grid of exactly 6 videos with preserved aspect ratio, add/replace via Media Manager, playsInline + looping + default-muted.
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence shows changes or confirmation for VideoMemorySection behavior, slot count (6), aspect ratio handling, or playback attributes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add the newly bundled hero background image to frontend/public/assets/generated and reference it via static URL (no backend routing).
missing_requirements.reason: No files were added in the diff, so the required asset placement under frontend/public/assets/generated is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a hidden file input and local file selection handler in HeroSection (file input ref + click/select handlers) even though uploading is supposed to be handled via the existing Media Manager flow.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asks to set a default hero background asset and keep Media Manager override behavior; it does not request adding a file input element in the Hero section.

hallucinated_features.description: Displays a fixed bottom-right 'No song uploaded' UI when there is no songUrl.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 specifies behavior when a song is present and the desired player popup; it does not request adding an explicit disabled-state popup message when no song is uploaded.
